Just ran across this ATM receipt from 1993. I grabbed some cash to buy Vs. at midnight. I remember writing the time and temp as a nod to the opening cards in the Jeremy video. Looks like it was a 45 min wait until my gf and I could run to the car and experience Go for the first time. And yes I got change from the $10.
    submitted by    /u/CHIDENCHI
